title: Shift Roster Lookup
summary: A hospital app answers 'who is on duty in this ward right now'. Fix it showing the wrong nurse, add handovers and coverage gaps, then answer half a million lookups in time.
followUps: What exactly does Collections.binarySearch return when the key is missing, and why is it encoded that way?
Why were lookups at the exact start of a shift right while the bug was there?
What is the cost of onDutyAt and uncovered for a ward with n shifts?
Shifts can now overlap during a handover period. What changes in the lookup, and what should the app show?
What did the assistant get wrong or leave out, and how did you notice?
